zone.title: Add a zone
zone.description: A zone pairs one heating actuator with one cooling actuator (e.g. a floor, or the whole house). Leave either blank if this zone only heats or only cools. Temperature unit follows Home Assistant's own system unit.

error.zone_needs_actuator: A zone needs at least a heating or a cooling actuator.
